task: Phase 7 observability acceptance criteria closure (P3.5.3, P3.5.5, P3.5.7, P3.5.11, P3.5.13)

criteria.title: Wait detection - concurrency
criteria.decisiveFinding: kind:'concurrency' declared in WaitState union (observability.ts:34) but never constructed anywhere (0 grep matches for a construction site). executeParallel() is dead code (only its own tests import it). Production coding path uses sequential iterateSubtasks(). agent-start-service.ts:550 hardcodes {parallel:false, workers:1}, and startTaskExecution() never reads options.parallel/options.workers.

criteria.title: Wait detection - context
criteria.decisiveFinding: Sibling artifact step-11-waits-ctx-blocking.png (verified genuine PNG, visually inspected) shows real WAITS sub-view rendering 'BLOCKING ANALYSIS - 1 blocked' / 'CTX 159.1% - compaction imminent' from a real driven run. Independently corroborated by this task's own drive (002-ctx-test-big, glm/glm-4.7) reaching 97.4% then 182.1% context usage in the live InspectView.

criteria.title: Cache hit accounting
criteria.decisiveFinding: glm/glm-4.7 via the local router returns cache_read_input_tokens: 2304, reproduced across 3 independent process runs (9 total calls). Full field-mapping chain confirmed correct by source inspection from raw provider response through @ai-sdk/anthropic, the ai package's usage normalization, stream-handler.ts, observability.ts, to AgentsView.tsx's cache-hit % calculation. A live driven session against this model rendered a populated 100% cache-hit figure in the TOKENS sub-view.

criteria.title: Graph topology - subagent nodes
criteria.decisiveFinding: SpawnSubagent tool-call traffic requires useAgenticOrchestration:true, which is never set to true anywhere in the codebase (2 total grep hits: the type declaration and the if-check). Both real task-start entry points (startTaskExecution, startSpecCreation) route to hardcoded TypeScript phase-pipeline orchestrators where the orchestrator LLM never gets an opportunity to call SpawnSubagent.

criteria.title: Throughput - 16ms coalescing under real event volume
criteria.decisiveFinding: Real events driven through the actual observability.ts attachToManager()/onStreamEvent/recomputeWait path at ~148-150 events/sec (3 consistent runs, all >= the 100/sec requirement). Snapshot emission count (~304-305) vs event count (~760) yields a ~2.5x coalescing ratio, confirming the 16ms coalescing genuinely collapses events. Zero event-loop stalls over 50ms in any run.
